div.p: If the container is offline, or the copy fails, nothing is deleted: the file waits in deploy/ and is retried on the next cycle.

Uploading into home/ instead does NOT hand the file over. home/ is a mirror of the container, one way only: a file that is in the bucket and not on the desktop looks exactly like one the user deleted, so the next save removes it again — into .persist-trash/.
Step 4 is why deploy/ can be a letterbox rather than storage: once delivered, the file is simply one of the user's own files, and the ordinary mirror keeps it.
